newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean shares end firm as local rates slip.
newsitem.headline: Chilean shares end firm as local rates slip.

text.p: Bucking Wall Street's slide, Chilean stocks started the year with a mild rally helped by a fall in local interest rates, said traders.
The bolsa is seen opening stable with investors waiting to take their cue from New York, they said.
"If Wall Street falls further, then this could hurt Chilean stocks," said one dealer.
The 40-share IPSA index, which was revalued on January 1 at 100 points, closed up 0.45 percent at 100.45 points. The general IGPA index firmed 0.18 percent to 4,911.56 points.
